basics.name: Bhavani D
basics.title: Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: I am a Java Full Stack Developer with 8+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance applications using modern frontend frameworks like React and Angular, along with robust backend solutions using Spring Boot. I focus on creating user friendly interfaces, optimizing microservices architectures, and enabling real-time data processing using messaging platforms such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.

bullets: Designed and developed responsive dealer and vehicle management interfaces using React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, HTML5, and CSS3, integrating them with Spring Boot microservices to enable real-time service scheduling and diagnostics workflows.

Built reusable UI components and dynamic validation-driven forms for customer and dealer operations, while implementing backend business logic using Java 17, Spring Boot, and Hibernate to support scalable request processing.

Implemented asynchronous frontend data handling with Axios and REST APIs, and developed backend persistence layers using Spring Data JPA with MySQL and MongoDB to ensure optimized data access and consistency.

Improved application performance by applying lazy loading, component memoization, and efficient state management on the frontend, while optimizing backend service execution through layered architecture and query tuning.

Developed secure end-to-end feature integrations by implementing JWT-based authentication with Spring Security and handling inter-service communication using RabbitMQ for reliable vehicle telemetry and notification processing.

Containerized full-stack applications using Docker and deployed them via Kubernetes-based CI/CD pipelines, supporting production monitoring, logging, and continuous delivery across cloud environments.
Built immersive streaming experiences for Disney+ using React 18, Next.js, and Redux Toolkit for global audiences.
Developed and optimized backend services with Spring Boot, Java 17, and GraphQL, improving data delivery and response times.
Integrated AWS-based microservices and Kafka to support event-driven, high-traffic streaming operations.
Improved content recommendation accuracy through real-time API integrations and analytics-driven features.
Implemented advanced logging and observability using Sentry, OpenTelemetry, and AWS CloudWatch.
Mentored junior developers on scalable UI design and full-stack best practices, strengthening team productivity.
Engineered FHIR-compliant APIs and patient dashboards using React, Spring Boot, and Azure, enhancing care coordination.
Modernized healthcare integration with GraphQL and RESTful APIs, ensuring interoperability across multiple hospital systems.
Built real-time data pipelines with Kafka Streams and Azure Event Hub for seamless clinical data synchronization.
Strengthened data security and compliance with Spring Security, JWT, and Azure AD under HIPAA and GDPR.
Established CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes, reducing release time by 50%.
Collaborated with healthcare teams to digitize patient workflows, driving efficiency and data transparency.
Developed enterprise-grade e-commerce applications using Spring MVC and Java, powering Hershey's retail platforms.
Automated product catalog and pricing synchronization using Spring Integration and legacy system connectors.
Improved transaction performance through optimized Oracle PL/SQL queries and Spring JDBC operations.
Implemented secure payment and user data flows using AWS IAM, S3, and PCI-compliant practices.
Deployed continuous integration pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, enabling faster rollout of promotions.
Partnered with business teams to launch digital campaigns that enhanced customer engagement and retention.
Developed responsive media management dashboards using AngularJS, HTML5, and Spring MVC.
Designed modular backend services in Java/J2EE, improving performance and scalability across applications.
Integrated Spring REST APIs with third-party analytics and reporting tools for real-time insights.
Optimized SQL operations and caching for faster data retrieval and transaction efficiency.
Migrated legacy JSP/Servlet systems to Angular + Spring MVC, enhancing UI responsiveness.
Collaborated with QA and design teams through Agile sprints to deliver high quality, customer-focused releases.
